info.description:
RAG tutor for Computer Science learning. Add sources (PDFs, audio, YouTube, GitHub, web), ask questions with cited answers (JSON or streaming), and use tutoring tools.

All `/api/v1` routes are rate limited per IP. If the server sets `API_KEY`, send it as `X-API-Key`. Errors always have the shape `{"error": {"code", "message", "details?"}}`.
info.title: AI Study Mentor API

post.description:
Same input as `/ask`. The response is `text/event-stream` with these events, in order:

- `meta`: `{chunks, prompt?}` (retrieved context, sent first)
- `token`: `{text}` (zero or more answer fragments)
- `done`: `{model}` (end of a successful answer)
- `error`: `{code, message}` (terminal; `code` is `llm_unavailable`, `llm_error` or `retrieval_error`)
